user.title: MeTube
user.description: Address of your MeTube server. If you installed the MeTube app from this repository, keep the suggested value.

data_description.url: For example http://local-metube:8081 (the app) or http://192.168.1.10:8081 (Docker on another machine).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach MeTube at this address.

abort.already_configured: This MeTube server is already configured.

init.title: Default download options
init.description: Used by the link box and by the download action when it does not specify them.

data_description.folder: Subfolder of the download folder (e.g. Rock). Leave empty for the main folder.
data_description.quality: For audio: best, 320, 192 or 128 (bitrates depend on the format). For video: a resolution.

error.format_mismatch: This format does not match the chosen type (audio: mp3, m4a, opus, flac, wav, auto; video: any, mp4, ios).

download_failed.message: MeTube could not add the download: {error}

not_loaded.message: No MeTube server is set up and loaded.

download.name: Download
download.description: Asks MeTube to download a link (YouTube or any site yt-dlp supports). Fields left empty use the integration's default options.

url.name: URL
url.description: Link of the video, track or playlist.

format.name: Format
format.description: Audio: mp3, m4a, opus, flac, wav, auto. Video: any, mp4, ios.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Subfolder of the download folder (e.g. Rock). Leave empty for the main folder.

playlist_item_limit.name: Playlist item limit
playlist_item_limit.description: Maximum number of playlist items to download (0 = all).

config_entry_id.name: MeTube
config_entry_id.description: MeTube server to use, if you have more than one.
